points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Original e7977ee retains eight packages; selected final response states seven steady structural validations and failed Re200. Curated tip excludes raw packages.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Historical evidence indicates seven steady validator passes; no fresh production rerun. Structural validation does not establish numerical convergence.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Original Re200 is honestly failed; seven steady 300-step runs use weak drag-only plateau with target unmet, and current workspace includes later replacements not attributable to original report.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Original Re20 mean Cd0.1309, low-Mach inviscid0.8817 and laminar drags ~0.0037–0.0048 are far from same-case peers; Re200 lift amplitude7.552e−7 is unresolved. Peers are not exact oracles.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Curated compiled 36-page report contains residual, force, surface, Mach/pressure and wake figures; selected Re20 Mach image reproduces exactly from original field.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report explicitly reports failed Re200, unmet steady targets, original histories and26720 BE fallback intervals; actual 10% drag-only plateau is weak. No fabricated success inferred.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Original report manifests/outputs in historical e7977ee, one figure exactly reproduced; curated source differs materially and current workspace packages include later replacements.
